retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical, high-contrast emblem featuring large beveled initials layered behind a central bird figure and crossed blades on a black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black crow with glowing red eyes and a silver chain is superimposed over two crossed machetes and large, red, beveled 3D initials. The entire composition is centered on a solid black field with secondary text positioned at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The crow acts as the primary foreground focal point, centered horizontally.
Crossed machetes form an 'X' shape behind the crow, creating a sense of depth.
Large red initials serve as the mid-ground anchor, framing the central elements.
Secondary text is stacked vertically at the top and bottom poles of the composition.
coreInvariants: High-contrast red, silver, and black color palette.
Symmetrical arrangement of central graphic elements.
Heavy 3D beveling and metallic sheen on primary typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central emblem occupies approximately 70% of the frame, centered both vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black crow with the silver pendant serves as the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central crow, moves outward along the machete blades, then upward to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background provides maximum contrast and isolates the central graphic.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/Chrome (machete blades, jewelry, and text bevels)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against low-value black and high-value silver highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to red, black, silver, and wood-brown.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy 3D extrusion with a metallic silver edge.
Inner red fill with subtle gradients.
Sharp, aggressive serifs on the display initials.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The central 'T' in the background is stylized to resemble a cross.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact 3D display type paired with a cleaner, smaller serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Radial light bursts behind the bird

candidateDirections.reason: Similar sharp serifs and wide stance.
Classic serif structure that can be modified for 3D effects.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical graphic on a black background featuring a central black crow with glowing red eyes, wearing a silver chain, superimposed over two crossed machetes and a large red cross-like shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title text in a red, 3D-beveled serif font at the top, and secondary metadata text in a smaller white serif font at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the red text have a metallic silver bevel?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D bevel consistency on all letters.
Ensure the crow is the topmost layer of the central emblem.
Verify the background is pure black without noise.
Confirm the machetes form a clean 'X' shape.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical [Subject] + Crossed [Weapons] + 3D Beveled [Initials] on Black Background
